title: Unit – 4 : Session – 5 : SLO – 2  |  Multiple Bus Organization — Match the Following
sections: 1. Address Bus — B. Connects CPU to main memory for address transfer.
2. Data Bus — C. Transfers actual data between components.
3. Control Bus — A. Carries control signals between components.
4. System Bus — E. Main bus connecting CPU to memory and I/O.
5. Local Bus — D. Dedicated high-speed processor-cache connection.
6. Bus Arbiter — G. Decides which device gets bus access.
7. Crossbar Switch — F. Allows simultaneous multiple data transfers.
8. Harvard Architecture — H. Uses separate buses for instructions and data.
9. Bus Width — I. Number of parallel lines in a bus.
10. Dual Bus Architecture — J. Uses separate buses for memory and I/O access.
